SELECT r.fiscal_period_label, r.period_start_date, r.period_end_date, r.first_fiscal_week, r.last_fiscal_week, r.fully_loaded,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date = r.period_end_date) AS stock_rows,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT store_key, product_key, week_ending_date FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date = r.period_end_date GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_keys,
 (SELECT count(distinct etl_loaded_at) FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date = r.period_end_date) AS loads
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar r WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' ORDER BY fiscal_period

SELECT w.week_ending_date, count(*) AS rows_, count(DISTINCT (s.store_id, p.sku)) AS natural_keys,
 sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id>=900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rows_900plus,
 sum(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test_rows,
 sum(CASE WHEN w.closing_units<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neg,
 sum(w.closing_units) AS units, min(w.etl_loaded_at) AS minload, max(w.etl_loaded_at) AS maxload
FROM fact_stock_week w JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=w.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=w.product_key
WHERE w.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-09' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_week, min(f.sale_date) AS d0, max(f.sale_date) AS d1, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS ids, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS rl,
 sum(f.quantity) AS qty, sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id<900 THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS store_qty,
 sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS clean_qty,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos, min(f.etl_loaded_at) AS l0, max(f.etl_loaded_at) AS l1
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 15 AND 22
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH stock AS (
  SELECT cp.category, SUM(w.closing_units) AS closing_units
  FROM fact_stock_week w
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = w.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = w.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE w.week_ending_date = DATE '2026-09-27' AND s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY 1
), sold AS (
  SELECT cp.category, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_4wk
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-24' AND DATE '2026-09-20' AND s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 5 AS fiscal_period, COALESCE(st.category, so.category) AS category, st.closing_units, so.units_4wk,
  ROUND(so.units_4wk/4.0,1) AS avg_weekly_units, ROUND(st.closing_units / (so.units_4wk/4.0), 2) AS weeks_of_cover
FROM stock st FULL JOIN sold so ON so.category = st.category ORDER BY 3

SELECT count(DISTINCT s.store_id) AS stores, count(DISTINCT p.sku) AS skus,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cs.close_date IS NOT NULL THEN s.store_id END) AS closed_stores_in_stock,
 sum(CASE WHEN cs.close_date IS NOT NULL THEN w.closing_units ELSE 0 END) AS closed_store_units,
 sum(CASE WHEN cp.delisted_on IS NOT NULL THEN w.closing_units ELSE 0 END) AS delisted_units,
 sum(CASE WHEN cp.delisted_on IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delisted_rows,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(w.closing_value - w.closing_units * p.standard_unit_cost) > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS value_mismatch,
 count(*) AS n, count(cp.sku) AS with_current
FROM fact_stock_week w JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=w.store_key JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=w.product_key LEFT JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE w.week_ending_date = DATE '2026-09-27'
